source_invariant.old_new_fault_semantics: 8c and ec68 both inject immediate error at callback1 and unconditional acknowledged-STOP+80ms delay+CONT at callback3. ec68 adds observation only; original callbacks/deadlines/audit retained.
call_chain: One cleanup origin, initial drain deadline+100ms, quiescence deadline+250ms, final drain deadline+1s.
Callback1 returns injected transient error; initial drain can recover on a later valid empty session scan.

Callback3 is a global cleanup scan count, not a phase selector. It usually reaches first quiescence scan after callback2 initial recovery; if early inventories fail, it can still be initial drain. A phase skipped for expired deadline can also change where later calls occur.
Stopped command acknowledgement uses the supplied absolute deadline. No80ms reservation exists after acknowledgement; actual sleep is at least80ms, and real ps output/parsing/identity work follows.
If call3 fails during initial drain, later valid quiescence and final census can still recover; no callback3-success assertion is required.

If a scan exhausts quiescence, incomplete history is cleared. Two complete quiet stable censuses must still finish by the same250ms deadline; final drain success cannot clear an existing quiescence failure.
Post-cleanup audit has its own unchanged250ms deadline after cleanup and is not funded by quiescence remaining time.
source_invariant.conditional_shortfall: A late stop acknowledgement with remaining time below actual80ms delay plus ps/census cost can exhaust the phase. Even remaining>80ms alone does not prove enough time for subsequent required fresh stable census. The positive test propagates cleanup/audit error rather than qualify incomplete evidence.
